Polly slides away on her belly past the goal and out of view to the right
Pax stands alone holding his stick near the puck, little musical notes bobbing above his head
Pax flicks the puck with his stick and sends it sliding into the goal net

Polly works a claw machine with Pax beside her. The machine is full of penguin plush toys including large plushes of Pax (top right of the cabinet) and a pink Polly-like plush with headphones; also a Pudgy Penguins logo sign on top.
inside the claw machine: the claw over a pile of penguin plushes, giant Pax plushes behind (no real lead; also no_lead).
Pax beside the machine, bumping it; the Pax and Polly plushes are visible through the glass at the left (checked at full resolution on f240).
inside the claw machine again: the Polly-like plush tumbles into the prize chute (no real lead).
wide at the machine: Polly takes out and hugs the pink penguin plush with headphones (a Polly copy) next to the cabinet of Pax plushes.

spans.view: with the two of them side by side on a rose wooden bench

beats.text: Polly giggles with her eyes closed, holding a two-scoop cone, while Pax nibbles his mint cone with his eyes closed
Polly keeps laughing with her eyes shut as the top scoop of her ice cream slides off her cone while Pax stares at it
Pax lunges sideways and catches the falling scoop on top of his own cone
Pax sits back holding the stacked cone with a sweat drop while Polly laughs with her eyes shut
Pax reaches over and sets the scoop back on top of Polly's cone
Polly gives her mended cone a flat, half-lidded stare while Pax looks back at her
Pax rubs the side of his head with a flipper and smiles sheepishly with his eyes closed while Polly stares flatly
Pax raises his flipper high and his mint scoop tips off his cone and drops onto the snow while Polly watches wide-eyed
Pax holds his empty cone and stares wide-eyed while Polly looks at him in surprise
Polly bursts out laughing with a fin over her beak while Pax chuckles with his eyes closed
